definitions.HashMap: Key to value store with O(1) average lookup
definitions.Linked List: Nodes chained by pointers; O(n) search
definitions.Heap: Tree giving fast access to the min or max
definitions.Graph: Nodes joined by edges; models networks
definitions.Deque: Double-ended queue: add or remove at both ends
definitions.TCP: Reliable network protocol, not a data structure
definitions.SELECT: SQL command that reads rows from a table
definitions.Docker: Container tool, not a data structure
definitions.REST: API style, not a data structure
definitions.OAuth: Authorisation standard, not a data structure
definitions.Git rebase: Rewrites commit history, not a data structure
definitions.Regex: Text pattern language, not a data structure

definitions.Heap push: Sift-up through the tree height: O(log n)
definitions.Heap pop: Sift-down through the tree height: O(log n)
definitions.B-tree search: Wide balanced tree used by databases: O(log n)
definitions.Merge sort: Divide and merge: O(n log n)
definitions.Matrix mult: The naive version is O(n cubed)

definitions.UPDATE: SQL command that changes existing rows
definitions.JOIN: SQL clause that combines rows from two tables
definitions.GROUP BY: SQL clause that groups rows for aggregates
definitions.HAVING: SQL clause that filters groups after GROUP BY
definitions.WHERE: SQL clause that filters rows before grouping
definitions.git commit: Git command that saves a snapshot
definitions.docker run: Docker command that starts a container
definitions.curl: Command line tool for HTTP requests
definitions.chmod: Shell command that changes file permissions
definitions.ssh: Shell command for secure remote login
